description: Fact-check one claim against live retrieved sources. Returns verdict (supported, refuted or unverified), sufficiency, a conformal guarantee, per-part atoms and a signed provenance receipt binding the evidence and model route. Sufficiency other than sufficient (insufficient means one weak source; no_sources, no_stance, conflict) is a reason to abstain or escalate. When guarantee.certified is true, the error probability is calibrated to at most guarantee.alpha, distribution-free, so supported plus certified can gate a decision. Compound claims are verified part by part and recombined weakest-link, so a true part cannot carry a false one. Limits: evidence is retrievable web, encyclopedic and news sources, so very recent, private, niche-technical or opinion claims return unverified or insufficient rather than a guess. The guarantee exists only on calibrated deployments, for claims exchangeable with the calibration set. It checks source support, not ultimate truth. Free.

claim.description: The factual claim as ONE complete declarative sentence (not a question or a paragraph).

max_sources.description: How many sources to retrieve and weigh (1-10).
